MCF-stack · Literature search · 8 November 2026

Mean curvature flow
and its special solutions

A bibliography of shrinkers, translators, expanders, other special flows, and the theory used to study them. Search by author, title, arXiv ID, DOI, or topic.

894 bibliographic records · 172 individually selected references · Remaining entries screened automatically from titles and, when available, abstracts.

Coverage, not a claim of completeness. All pages of eight recorded arXiv queries were retrieved. Five Crossref searches each retrieved their first 1,000 ranked matches. MathSciNet and Google Scholar did not yield usable search results in this session. Older, unindexed, and differently titled papers may be missing. Subject labels are discovery aids, not verified theorem hypotheses. This search did not review the proofs.

Topic counts overlap: a paper may concern more than one kind of solution. Supporting theory without a specific solution topic remains in the all-topics view.

Years use publisher publication metadata when available; otherwise they are arXiv first-submission years. The preprint year is shown separately when different. A DOI or journal reference is not a proof-verification badge. Corrections and separately published expositions may have their own records.

Sources: arXiv API, Crossref publisher metadata, the MCF-stack reference list, selected author publication pages, and original publisher records. Public bibliographic metadata only; no supplied PDFs or private research files are included.

This research index is separate from the five-chapter MCF-stack reading collection. The collection's catalogue, mathematical statements, permanent tags, and routes were not edited.
